M/u cutter BHA together w/ torque tool for spaceout verification. Remeasured BHA components and pups/dp below torque tool
RIH w/ cutter BHA. Engaged torque tool in tieback adapter, p/u 21. 44m up to position knives at cutting depth of 139,7m middle of tieback adapter)

Took parameters 300l/min 22bar, 400l/min 49bar, 500l/min 85bar. Cut tieback adapter at 139,7m w/ 300l/min 19bar, 80rpm 2-8knm. As pressure decreased, increased pump rate to 400l/min 7bar, 460l/min 5bar, 530l/min 2bar. This pressure drop indicated that knives fully retracted and tieback adapter cut
POOH w/ cutting BHA
L/d cutting BHA
P/u and m/u fishing BHA
RIH on 5,5in DP to 128 meter and latched on to 10 3/4in tieback fish
Attempted to pull up to 80t overpull, worked the string several times up/down. No success
POOH with spear BHA on 5,5in DP f/ 129m to 27m
R/b spear BHA
P/u torque tool and cutter assembly and 1x joint of 5,5in DP, m/u to TDS. Tested knives with 300 l/min, OK. Broke out TDS, continued m/u BHA to 29m
RIH w/ 5,5in DP and tagged top of tie back adapter with 2t at 124m. Filled string. Evaluated new cutting depth
Broke out TDS and POOH with cutter BHA Installed lifting nubbing and pulled out cutter BHA
Changed knives in cutter to 13,5in ones. M/u TDS and tested cutter knives w/ 310 l/min, OK
RIH w/ 5,5dp and tagged top of tie back adapter with 2t at 124m. Filled string and broke circulation w/ 310 l/min 19 bar

Positioned knives at 139. 7m. Increased flow rate to 500 l/min 82 bar, started rotating w/ 100rpm, started cutting tieback adapter w/ 1-9knm 60 bar, increased to 140rpm 1-7knm, 495 l/min 27bar, then 600l/min 17bar. Good indication of cut, lifted fish on knives, then pumps off
POOH w/ cutter BHA
L/d torque tool and cutter BHA
P/u spear BHA set spear in catch position. RIH to 26m
RIH w/ spear to 106m. M/u TDS, took up/down weights 73t/70t. Continued in hole and latched onto fish at 128. 5m, pulled free with 3t overpull
Broke-out TDS and POOH w/ spear BHA. Observed fish on spear. Released spear and l/d fish, r/b spear
Cleaned and cleared rig floor
Performed pre-job meeting to p/u milling BHA
Carried out PMS and dailys while waiting for crew change helicopters
P/u and m/u milling BHA RIH same to 98m
Performed pre-job meeting w/ oncoming crew
RIH w/ milling BHA from 98 to 135m
Took up/down weights 85t/82t, parameters 80rpm 1-5knm, 2000l/min 14bar

RIH and tagged tieback adapter cut at 139,7m, marked milling distance on pipe. P/u, started pumping and rotation 2000l/min 13bar 80rpm. RIH and started milling tieback adapter. Torque 2-7knm, wob 1t. Observed almost no vibration in the start and very noticeable vibration effects in the end of milling period. Totally milled ca 14cm down
Investigated water leak on TDS
